# make_periodic_graph_from_binary_grid { #mofography.winding_percolation.make_periodic_graph_from_binary_grid }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> 2D toy lattice helper for winding demos and tests, not MOF segmentation graphs.

```python
winding_percolation.make_periodic_graph_from_binary_grid(
    grid,
    allow_diagonals=False,
    node_radius=1.0,
    edge_radius=1.0,
)
```

Convert a binary 2D periodic lattice into a MultiDiGraph for winding percolation.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

grid : np.ndarray
    2D array where ``1`` (or truthy) entries represent pore voxels.  The
    lattice is treated as periodic along both axes.
allow_diagonals : bool
    Include diagonal neighbors (8-connectivity) when ``True``.  Otherwise,
    only orthogonal neighbors (4-connectivity) are considered.
node_radius, edge_radius : float
    Values stored on each node/edge so that downstream helpers expecting
    radii attributes continue to work.
